race.comment: IMMORTAL SPIRIT (4) went to the front, dictated, then held off a strong late challenge to score narrowly over this distance at Balaklava last start. Back a little in grade so with the confidence restored back-to-back wins are on the radar. THE ICE CUTTER (8) settled at the back of a small field then battled on well without threatening last time out over 1200m at Strathalbyn. Open to plenty of improvement over a bit more ground at the fourth run of the preparation. EKANITE (1) is back after 200 days on the sidelines. Lost his way a bit last prep but he has had a reset and faces a modest field for this return. Draws a nice gate and it will be no surprise to see him fighting out the finish. KUSHAN KHANIVALE (6) lines up for just the second time in two months. Not a prolific winner but goes well when fresh and a race of this class is not out of reach. ROB THE BANK (3) was strong through the line at the end of 1200m at Strathalbyn recently. Nicely placed out to today's journey.
